title: Easy and fun way to get to Sagrada Familia
text:
We took the Best of Barcelona half day tour with Barcelona City Tours on Nov 10.  We selected this tour because we were picked up at the ship and facilitated entry to Sagrada Familia.  That being said, we really enjoyed the rest of the tour as well - scenic overview from Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya and stroll through the narrow streets of Old Town.  We shared the van with three other couples.

title: Excellent Tour with Barcelona Day Tours!
text:
**Title: Excellent Tour with Barcelona Day Tours!**

We had a wonderful experience with Barcelona Day Tours during our recent cruise stop in Barcelona!

Our guide and driver were fantastic. Both went above and beyond to make sure we had a great day. They were friendly, professional, and made sure everything ran smoothly from start to finish.

What impressed us most was how they handled an unexpected port strike. Our guide and driver were aware of the situation and stayed on top of it throughout the day. They made sure the strike did not affect our tour and that we returned to the ship on time.
author: heidimD4320QI

title: Great tour and guide!
text: Our tour guide was very knowledgeable, and it was terrific that he picked us up at our ship’s port and then dropped us off at our hotel! Highly recommend Spain Day Tours!!!

title: Great tour and very useful for cruise travelers
text: We had such a great experience with this tour. Very useful for those arriving in Barcelona after a cruise, since we've just got off the cruise terminal, did the tour and were dropped off right at the hotel, without having to handle with luggage and other transportation. Our tour guide Ophelie did a great job taking us around and explaining everything along the way

title: Pickup at the port by our...
text: Pickup at the port by our driver/guide who was prompt and friendly. We were the only ones on the tour (another group didn’t show up) so it was very personalized. We got a great overview of the city and even stopped to take pictures. We learned a lot of history and also were able to get our bearings a bit. I wish I could remember our guide’s name because he was fantastic!  Highly recommend.
author: Susan_S

title: Beautiful discoveries with a competent guide
text: Very beautiful experience with the guide Jaidi from Barcelona, available, well organized and attentive to the needs and desires of the group. This guide speaks perfectly, in particular, in French. Pleasant contact. I recommend the excursion and the guide.
